title: Length of a timed insertion's output
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a linearly ordered type, let $x \in \alpha$, and let $xs$ be a finite list of elements of $\alpha$. The return value of the timed ordered insertion of $x$ into $xs$ is a list of length $\abs{xs} + 1$.
hypotheses_covered: α is a linearly ordered type
x is an element of α
xs is a list over α
replaced: The list returned by inserting $x$ into $\mathit{xs}$ has length $\abs{\mathit{xs}} + 1$.
